summary: C runtime error-exit handler matching the CRT _amsg_exit pattern (ABI name CRT___amsg_exit). If the flag dword_8D3EBC equals 1 it calls sub_5932BA (display of the error/assertion dialog), then calls sub_5932F3 with the incoming error code NumberOfBytesWritten, and finally calls the registered exit-function pointer off_5E65B0 with the argument 0xFF, returning its result. Called by CRT stubs for allocation failures and runtime errors (MemoryAllocationStub, CriticalSectionLazyInitEnter, TLSValueRetrievalWithInit, sub_592AF4, sub_592BAD, sub_592F2C, AmsgExitRuntimeError, NullTerminatedIntArrayCopyWithAlloc).

local_names.NumberOfBytesWritten: incoming error/runtime code passed through to sub_5932F3
local_names.dword_8D3EBC: error-display flag; when 1 the dialog path runs
local_names.off_5E65B0: registered exit function pointer called with 0xFF

operations.description: If dword_8D3EBC == 1, call sub_5932BA to display the error/assertion dialog.
Call sub_5932F3 with the incoming NumberOfBytesWritten to process the error/exit code.
Call the registered exit function pointer off_5E65B0 with argument 0xFF and return its result.
